scriptItem.label: Open ADS Asset Catalog
scriptItem.scriptCode:
server = hou.getenv('ADS_CATALOG_SERVER') or hou.getenv('ADS_RESOLVER_SERVER') if not server: result = hou.ui.readInput( 'ADS server URL', buttons=('Open', 'Cancel'), initial_contents='http://127.0.0.1:8789') if result[0] == 0: server = result[1]
if server: profile = hou.getenv('ADS_CATALOG_PROFILE') or hou.getenv('ADS_RESOLVER_PROFILE') or 'main' args = 'server={};profile={}'.format(server, profile)
category = hou.getenv('ADS_CATALOG_CATEGORY') if category: args += ';category={}'.format(category)
department = hou.getenv('ADS_CATALOG_DEPARTMENT') if department: args += ';department={}'.format(department)
query = hou.getenv('ADS_CATALOG_QUERY') if query: args += ';q={}'.format(query)
resolve_mode = hou.getenv('ADS_CATALOG_RESOLVE_MODE') or hou.getenv('ADS_RESOLVER_MODE') if resolve_mode: args += ';resolve_mode={}'.format(resolve_mode)
hou.ui.setSharedLayoutDataSource( hou.AssetGalleryDataSource('ADS', args))
